serverInfo.name: hirepulse-tools
serverInfo.description: 15 pay-per-use data APIs and MCP tools for AI agents: job search, ATS boards, competitor Google Ads, company intent, tech stacks, SEO, and transcripts.

freeTier: 5 free calls/day per IP at https://gethirepulse.xyz or $5/month Apify platform credit

tools.name: aliexpress_search_scraper
tools.description: Export AliExpress search results to a spreadsheet without coding: product title, price in your currency, original price and discount, rating, units sold, image and product link. 60 products per page. Also as JSON for Python, n8n and AI agents.
tools.price: $2.50 per 1,000 products (pay per result, no subscription). Free Apify plan: 100 products per run.

tools.name: google_ads_transparency_scraper
tools.description: Extract live Google ads by domain from Google Ads Transparency Center. Get ad preview images, formats and first/last shown dates as clean JSON.
tools.price: $0.005 per domain checked + $0.0015 per ad returned. Domains with no ads cost $0.

tools.name: company_intent_radar
tools.description: Enrich any company domain with live hiring data, active Google ads, SEO traffic and intent scores in a single pay-per-use API call.
tools.price: $0.03 per company report, charged only when the full report was produced. Free plan: hiring and email signals for 5 companies.

tools.name: ats_job_pulse
tools.description: Extract open jobs, published salary ranges and the technologies they mention from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee and SmartRecruiters. Pay-per-use ATS data API.
tools.price: $0.05 per company whose job board was found and processed, however many jobs it has. Companies that are not found, and failed ones, are not charged.

tools.name: google_jobs_scraper
tools.description: Search Google Jobs in 90+ countries. Extract job titles, company names, parsed salaries, contract types and direct apply links as clean JSON.
tools.price: $0.005 per search that returns jobs + $0.001 per job.

tools.name: keyword_search_volume
tools.description: Google monthly search volume, CPC and competition for your keywords, plus keyword ideas, in bulk via API.

tools.name: domain_seo_overview
tools.description: Inspect website titles, meta descriptions, sitemap observations and Google Autocomplete suggestions. Native mode does not measure organic traffic, ranking positions, keyword search volumes or CPC; unavailable metrics remain null.
tools.price: Native/public-evidence mode emits no domain-lookup or domain-result charges. An Actor start event is still listed at $0.00005 per GB (minimum one event), and applicable Apify charges may apply. Review the live Pricing tab. Paid SEO-database events are separate and are not activated by this example.

tools.name: youtube_transcript_scraper
tools.description: Get transcripts of YouTube videos and Shorts in bulk, with timestamps, as JSON or plain text.
tools.price: $0.003 per delivered transcript. Videos without captions, unavailable videos and failed fetches are not charged.

tools.name: website_tech_stack_detector
tools.description: Enrich company domains with observed website technologies, advertising pixels, frontend frameworks, and DNS email signals in a single API call.
tools.price: $0.005 per domain checked + $0.001 per detected tech. Domains with no stack cost $0.

tools.name: ats_detector
tools.description: Detect which applicant tracking system any company uses (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, etc.) and extract official careers board endpoints.
tools.price: $0.005 per domain checked. Undetected boards cost $0.

tools.name: company_contact_details_finder
tools.description: Find publicly listed business contact information from company websites. Export corporate emails, phone numbers, contact forms, and social links.
tools.price: $0.005 per domain checked + $0.001 per public contact found.

tools.name: b2b_account_research_agent
tools.description: Autonomous account intelligence combining careers hiring velocity, web technology stack, Google ads presence, and verified digital footprint into a structured dossier.

tools.name: ai_search_brand_visibility_radar
tools.description: Audit website readiness for AI search engines and crawler agents (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude). Inspect robots directives, headers, llms.txt, and JSON-LD schema.
tools.price: $0.02 per returned brand visibility audit report.

tools.name: mcp_x402_server_grader
tools.description: Benchmark MCP server tools and x402 payment configurations. Audits tool schema descriptions, token efficiency, payment challenges, and Base network readiness.

tools.name: shopify_to_llms_generator
tools.description: Sample product catalogs from accessible public store feeds and draft an agent-ready llms.txt format with structured product attributes, prices, and variants.

tools.name: viral_product_radar
tools.description: Research product-related TikTok videos with source links, creator breadth and history. Measure growth on the same videos after6+ hours; no sales forecasts.
tools.price: $0.02 per delivered report; Clockworks collection is separate and capped ($0.04 total by default).
